mapper.select: SELECT INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE AS inquiryTypeCode, INQUIRY_TYPE_NAME AS inquiryTypeName FROM INQUIRY_TYPE ORDER BY INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE ASC

SELECT i.INQUIRY_CODE AS inquiryCode, i.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE AS inquiryTypeCode, t.INQUIRY_TYPE_NAME AS inquiryTypeName, i.MEMBER_CODE AS memberCode, i.TITLE AS title, i.CONTENT AS content, i.INQUIRY_IMG AS inquiryImg, CASE WHEN i.ANSWER IS NULL THEN 'WAITING' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END AS status, TO_CHAR(i.INQUIRY_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS inquiryDate FROM INQUIRY i JOIN INQUIRY_TYPE t ON i.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE = t.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE WHERE i.MEMBER_CODE = TO_NUMBER(#{memberCode})
AND (t.INQUIRY_TYPE_NAME = #{type} OR TO_CHAR(i.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE) = #{type})
ORDER BY i.INQUIRY_CODE DESC

SELECT i.INQUIRY_CODE AS inquiryCode, i.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE AS inquiryTypeCode, t.INQUIRY_TYPE_NAME AS inquiryTypeName, i.MEMBER_CODE AS memberCode, i.TITLE AS title, i.CONTENT AS content, i.INQUIRY_IMG AS inquiryImg, CASE WHEN i.ANSWER IS NULL THEN 'WAITING' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END AS status, TO_CHAR(i.INQUIRY_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS inquiryDate, i.ANSWER AS answerContent, TO_CHAR(i.ANSWER_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS answerDate FROM INQUIRY i JOIN INQUIRY_TYPE t ON i.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE = t.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE WHERE i.INQUIRY_CODE = TO_NUMBER(#{inquiryCode})
